prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling hospital corridor scene. On the left, a nurse in blue scrubs stands holding a clipboard, looking at a patient in a wheelchair who is sitting on the chair near the wall. The patient wears a grey blanket and looks up at the nurse. Next to the wheelchair, a small potted fern sits on the floor, its green leaves contrasting with the sterile tiles. In the center, a doctor in a white coat points at an X-ray film held by a technician in dark jeans. The technician holds the film up for inspection, standing next to a rolling metal cart loaded with medical supplies. A worried woman in a yellow dress stands beside the doctor, looking at the X-ray with concern. To the right, an elderly man in a beige cardigan leans on a wooden cane, waiting patiently by a closed door. Beside him, a young boy in a striped shirt plays with a red toy car on the floor. A golden retriever dog lies calmly next to the boy, resting its head on its paws. Further down the hall, a janitor in orange overalls mops the floor, pushing a bucket on wheels. A security guard in a black uniform stands near the exit, watching the hallway. A vending machine glows softly against the far wall, stocked with colorful drinks. A clock on the wall shows the time above the vending machine. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no fire or smoke present in the corridor.
